         The following is factual account of what I saw through my
         windows (sliding.glass door) on \'Tednesday, February 22, 1978

         entered my head at the time.
         The sun was shining and the»e was not a cloud in the sky .

         Fredericton from 5 :30 a.m. and decide it was near.ly time 11

         on Ch . 9, when my attent!on was drawn to bright flick~ring
         lights (like huge diamonds) in ' the sky advancing from the
         ~est. (my window faces directly north)
                             -
         I was spell bound by the lighxs and ' remernber "telling myself"
         to take my eyes frpm the lights and focus on what was ahea~
         of them . I s~w a huge, rather ,sharp-nosed plane , non
         reflective and steel grey in color . I t reminded me somewhat
         of the pictures of the missiles launched into orbit
         (excossivel1 long-compared to rear section) • My ~yes .
         returned to the lights which continued across my line of
         vision in an easterly direbtion (this side of St . Pius X
         Church and in front of the two Hydro power poles - my own
         points of refer~nce ) By this time I was getting only a
         rea'r view of the lights and moved' to the window to watch
         them out of sight when all of a sudden it was like a huge
         brilJiant search light had been turned on 1in the centre
         and rom whiCh a huge streamers of light went in all        '
         directions- reaching back almost to the Church . When ' I.
         first saw this huge ovalo£ light and thewer increasing
         brilliant rays the thought went through my mind (they are,
         using revolving mirrors - or gl,ass reflectors) !
